modelDetail: ICON-EU surface weather shaped sample bundle

tp.label: Precipitation since run
tp.description: Precipitation accumulated from initialization to this hour (synthetic)

precip.label: Precipitation
precip.description: Precipitation in the interval ending at this hour, differenced from the accumulation; null at initialization, which has no interval (synthetic)

pop.label: Chance of rain
pop.description: Share of the cells within 25 km of the place with 0.1 mm or more in the interval ending at this hour; null at initialization (synthetic)

clct.label: Total cloud
clct.description: Total cloud cover through the whole column (synthetic)

clcl.label: Low cloud
clcl.description: Cloud cover from the ground to 800 hPa (synthetic)

clch.label: High cloud
clch.description: Cloud cover between 400 hPa and the model top (synthetic)

pmsl.label: Pressure (MSL)
pmsl.description: Pressure reduced to mean sea level (synthetic)

cape.label: CAPE (mean layer)
cape.description: Convective available potential energy of a mean-layer parcel (synthetic)

ww.label: Present weather
ww.description: WMO present-weather interpretation code, a code-table entry; never averaged (synthetic)

tg.label: Surface temperature (SST proxy at sea)
tg.description: Model ground/skin temperature; over sea a model SST proxy, never an observation (synthetic)

precipitationNote: tp is the accumulation since initialization; precip is the amount in the interval ending at each step, obtained by differencing it and null at initialization, which has no interval. Each frame and series step declares that interval in precipIntervalHours.
seaTemperatureNote: tg is a ground/skin temperature. Over sea it would be a model SST proxy, never an observation; here it is a sample value and not a measurement of anything.
presentWeatherNote: ww is a WMO present-weather code, not a measurement: it belongs to the cell containing a location and is never interpolated, averaged or blended between models.
attribution: Synthetic sample data for tests — not a forecast
processing: Generated by scripts/sample-weather.mjs. The field is a smooth analytic function of position and lead time, not model output, and describes no real weather at any time.
